component.name: Hexwerk
component.summary: Addon manager for World of Warcraft on Linux

description.p: Hexwerk finds World of Warcraft installations inside Wine prefixes — Steam and Proton, Faugus and UMU, Heroic, Lutris, Bottles, PortProton or any folder you point it at — and manages the addons in every client flavour (retail, classic, classic era, anniversary and the PTR builds).

Sources are read without credentials: GitHub releases, Tukui and WoWInterface. Addons are recognised by the identifiers in their .toc file and by a fingerprint of the installed folder, so updates work even for addons that were installed by hand. Wago and CurseForge need a key and stay optional and off by default.
Installation is unpacking with folder correction, per client, with backup and trash. Search runs against a local index, so the catalogue stays usable while a scan is running.
Oberfläche auf Tauri 2 und Vue 3 umgestellt. Detailseite mit Bildergalerie, Reitern und Installationsstand je Spielordner. Vier Sprachen, drei Farbschemata, gemeinsame Bausteine mit den anderen Apps.
Katalog kommt fertig vom Dienst, Installieren aus ZIP und von einer Adresse, erkannte Fremdinstallationen, Zeichen folgt der Farbe des Themas.
Erste Fassung: Präfix-Erkennung, Katalog-Merge, Installation je Client.
